plugins.name: usage-detail
plugins.description: Local per-request usage analytics for ZCode: drill-down request rows (token breakdown, tok/s, cache rate), a live session side-panel dashboard, session health scores, model leaderboard, waste forensics, budget and burn alerts, list-price converted costs, activity heatmap and export - read-only local SQLite, zero model overhead.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 逐条用量明细：会话侧栏面板、两级钻取、tok/s 速率、每日明细钻取、零密钥配额条、分时计价、缓存率全链路、官方牌价折算、本地常驻面板
